newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas up in prompt, off in summer in busier trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas up in prompt, off in summer in busier trade.

text.p: IPE March natural gas futures rose on Thursday, recovering slightly from several days of losses, and all other contracts traded out to September but they mostly showed losses.
The volume, at 125 lots, was also higher than the last two days. Brokers were encouraged by the day's trading.

"Forget about the volumes," said one. "It was a very good day. There were some very close bid/offer spreads and a lot of price changes. It was probably the best day we've had since the first day. It feels like we saw some real trading."
A broker added that there are other players who would like to start trading on the IPE, but feel constrained by the high initial margins demanded by the exchange.
At an IPE lunch to launch the new contract officially on Thursday afternoon, exchange officials acknowledged that this issue has been raised as a potential problem.
